CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_disf(p_signalref character)
RETURNS numeric AS $$
DECLARE
    v_disf numeric;
BEGIN
    SELECT (10 - ABS(o.airtempc - 15) / 10.0) 
           * o.atmostransparency 
           * (1 - o.humidityrate / 200.0) 
           * ((100 - o.lunardistdeg) / 100.0)
    INTO v_disf
    FROM signals s
    JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
    JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    WHERE s.signalref = p_signalref;
    
    RETURN v_disf;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
